question: I need you to look into the actor collaborations and tell me how many actors have made more films with Yash Chopra than with any other director. This will help us understand his influence on the industry better.
sql:
-- Final clean query
WITH yash_actors AS (
    SELECT TRIM(mc.PID) as PID, COUNT(*) as yash_count
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN M_Director md ON mc.MID = md.MID AND md.PID = 'nm0007181'
    GROUP BY TRIM(mc.PID)
),
other_director_counts AS (
    SELECT TRIM(mc.PID) as PID, md.PID as director_pid, COUNT(*) as director_count
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN M_Director md ON mc.MID = md.MID AND md.PID != 'nm0007181'
    GROUP BY TRIM(mc.PID), md.PID
),
max_other AS (
    SELECT PID, MAX(director_count) as max_other_count
    FROM other_director_counts
    GROUP BY PID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as actor_count
FROM yash_actors ya
LEFT JOIN max_other mo ON ya.PID = mo.PID
WHERE ya.yash_count > COALESCE(mo.max_other_count, 0)
